messages:
sophia: Heads-up — last-minute visitor: Erika from Acme arriving ~2:45pm for a 30m demo. Needs a guest badge and a quiet spot. Also two boxes marked 'Redwood Demo' expected ~2:30. Can reception hold them and someone escort? cc @jorge-reception
jorge-reception: Got it. I can badge Erika when she checks in and keep the packages at the desk. Any labels to print or special handling?
matt-ops: Small conf B is free 2:30-3:15. Want me to reserve and post a "quiet demo" sign? :white_check_mark:
sophia: Yes please reserve conf B. And can we avoid using the projector (it's flaky)? I can bring my HDMI dongle if needed.
mina: I can meet Erika at the lobby and walk her up at 2:40. Also happy to sit in case we need tech help.
jorge-reception: Package note — courier said "left at front" sometimes gets mis-tagged. I'll scan the labels and stash in locker #3. If either box is 'Fragile' or needs signature I'll ping.
sophia: Thanks! One more: badge printer threw `ERROR: ribbon_empty` this morning, is there a spare ribbon in supplies?
people-ops-bot: Supply inventory: badge_ribbons = 2, spare_badges = 12. Please file a supply request if ribbons drop below 1: /requests/new
jorge-reception: I can swap a ribbon now, should be back online in ~5 min.
mina: Quick poll — after the demo, do we want to offer Erika tea/coffee? :tea: :coffee:
sophia: Tea would be lovely. Thanks everyone :heart:
jorge-reception: All set — conf B reserved, ribbon swapped, packages in locker #3. I'll badge and escort Erika at 2:45.
sophia: Perfect. Leaving the demo sign and dongle on the table now.
matt-ops: Thanks team!
